deckTitle: Power Pyramid Plumbing & Global Psyop Wrestling – Expansion Deck 01

cards.power: Soft-Power Philanthropy. Extract 3 Wealth from all players; rebrand it as a 'Scholarship.' Opponents lose 1 Free Will.
cards.lore: The original architect of soft-power imperialism, buying the world's education to launder resources and rewrite the map in Union Jack red.
cards.gradeReason: Role clear—empire laundering as charity—but needs Rhodes context to fully land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Victorian rhino in top hat dispensing scholarships from blood-soaked diamond bags. Style: colonial satirical illustration. Mood: smug imperialism.

cards.power: Bureaucratic Necromancy. Spawn 3 NGO Tokens in enemy territories. Regime change occurs in 2 turns.
cards.lore: The Rhodes-funded kindergarten that realized conquering nations with armies is messy, but conquering them with advisory boards is highly profitable.
cards.gradeReason: Spawn NGOs to regime-change enemies—you ARE the round table the moment you play it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Circle of fox-headed bureaucrats at round table, NGO flags replacing empire flags. Style: grotesque political cartoon. Mood: genteel predation.

cards.power: Waterloo Whisper. Crash the market, buy all discounted assets for a cost, then sip vintage Shiraz.
cards.lore: They didn't conquer nations; they just let them borrow themselves into submission. War is just high-yield investing.
cards.gradeReason: Crash market, buy dip, sip wine—three-step embodiment, zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Crow in banker suit toasting a crashing stock market with a goblet of red wine. Style: gilded-age satire. Mood: callous elegance.

cards.power: Regime Change Rerun. Label an opponent 'Worse Than Hitler.' Steal their oil resources immediately.
cards.lore: The establishment's favorite propaganda starter-pack, deployed whenever a sovereign state gets too uppity about its own natural resources.
cards.gradeReason: Slap the label, steal the oil—mechanic IS the psyop, no context needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Media puppet with megaphone stamping Hitler mustache on world map while oil derricks emerge behind it. Style: pop art agitprop. Mood: cynical bureaucratic evil.

cards.power: Fiat Alchemy. Create assets from thin air. All other players' assets are devoured by its web.
cards.lore: A private banking consortium masquerading as a government agency, designed to finance endless wars through infinite debt-slavery.
cards.gradeReason: Spider devouring value is vivid but performing 'Federal Reserve as entity' needs a beat at casual tables.
cards.artworkPrompt: Giant spider in federal seal top hat spinning dollar bills into a web, small figures tangled underneath. Style: dark surrealist finance illustration. Mood: systemic entrapment.

cards.power: Pre-Voting Compliance. Override an opponent's turn. Aladdin already simulated their move through the outcome.
cards.lore: Managing $21 trillion, this AI risk-management matrix doesn't predict the future—it simply owns the companies that dictate it.
cards.gradeReason: 'Aladdin already simulated your move' is brilliant but Aladdin-as-AI-system needs context for punchline to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Mechanical owl with glowing data streams overriding chess pieces on a world map. Style: cyberpunk finance. Mood: total informational dominance.

cards.power: Black Project Budget. Hide 5 Wealth Tokens. They cannot be taxed, tracked, or audited by this turn.
cards.lore: The deepest, darkest rabbit hole of global finance: the secret multi-trillion-dollar shadow fund used to finance off-the-books geopolitical network.
cards.gradeReason: Hide your money—it literally cannot be taxed or tracked. You ARE the black budget.
cards.artworkPrompt: Rabbit in military hat disappearing stacks of cash into shadow portal while auditors look the other way. Style: dark government satire. Mood: gleeful impunity.

cards.power: Programmable Tyranny. If an opponent plays a 'Free Thought' card, automatically expire their Bank Balance and freeze their turn.
cards.lore: Your money now comes with an expiration date and a moral score. How cute. Welcome to the algorithmic company store.
cards.gradeReason: Great mechanic but CBDC acronym creates half a second of required decoding at casual tables.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dog with digital collar leash connected to central bank server, expiration timer on its wallet. Style: dystopian tech satire. Mood: cheerful servitude.

cards.power: Inter-War Inflation. Trigger a Great Depression. Double the cost of all items for the next 3 turns to prepare for the next war.
cards.lore: WWI and WWII weren't separate events; they were one massive imperial divorce with a 21-year halftime show designed to bankrupt the peasantry.
cards.gradeReason: '21-year halftime show' framing is genius but the historical decode takes a beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Two world wars connected by smiley-face halftime banner, peasant silhouettes watching from rubble. Style: history textbook parody. Mood: grim comic distance.

cards.power: Whitewashed Résumé. Resurrect a discarded 'War Criminal' card and play it as a 'Valued Scientist.'
cards.lore: America's most successful unethical STEM scholarship program. 'Never Again' quickly became 'well, maybe just this once, for the space race.'
cards.gradeReason: Relabeling war criminal as valued scientist IS the card's action—flawless satire mechanic.
cards.artworkPrompt: Nazi uniform under NASA lab coat, rocket blueprint in hand, US flag in background. Style: cold war bureaucratic absurdism. Mood: institutional amnesia.

cards.power: Subterranean Escape. When attacked, retreat your assets to the D.U.M.B. Negate all surface damage.
cards.lore: Vast, Maglev-connected underground complexes funded by missing trillions, waiting for the surface world to finally destroy itself.
cards.gradeReason: Great mechanic but acronym needs the full-name parenthetical to click without pause.
cards.artworkPrompt: Underground megabase with maglev trains and glowing tunnels beneath scorched earth surface. Style: military spec-ops blueprint illustration. Mood: subterranean paranoia.

cards.power: Defensive Aggression. Occupy a neutral territory. Gain 3 'Spread Democracy' points while securing oil pipelines.
cards.lore: When 'spreading democracy' means backing warlords and expanding proxy wars. The peacekeepers wear white; the contractors wear Rolexes.
cards.gradeReason: 'Defensive Aggression' while securing pipelines—plays the contradiction perfectly, no briefing needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: UN blue-helmeted figure holding peace lily, oil pipeline emerging from their back. Style: satirical propaganda poster. Mood: institutional hypocrisy.

cards.power: Cold War Paranoia. Steal an opponent's strategy deck. You literally wrote the manual on post-war espionage.
cards.lore: The CIA's favorite ex-Nazi. He lost one war, so he decided to start another one that never ends, founding modern intelligence on a bedrock of war crimes.
cards.gradeReason: Compelling character card but 'Gehlen' requires historical recognition to fully ignite at casual tables.
cards.artworkPrompt: German shepherd in SS uniform now wearing CIA badge, holding classified files. Style: cold war spy thriller illustration. Mood: institutional evil recycled.

cards.power: Strategy of Tension. Trigger a False Flag. Blame the player to your left and steal their public support tokens.
cards.lore: NATO's secret 'stay-behind' armies that realized the best way to keep people afraid of communists was to do the terrorizing themselves.
cards.gradeReason: Trigger false flag, blame neighbor, steal credibility—three moves you instantly embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Shadowy gladiator figure setting a building afire while pointing accusatory finger at opponent. Style: dark ops agitprop. Mood: calculated provocation.

cards.power: Color Revolution. Discard 2 'Aid' cards to overthrow whomever is currently in first place.
cards.lore: United States Agency for Infrastructure and Interference. Building bridges straight to regime changes and data vacuums.
cards.gradeReason: Spend aid cards to topple the leader—mechanic is the critique, zero explanation required.
cards.artworkPrompt: Beaver building a bridge that leads directly to a government overthrow, USAID logo on hard hat. Style: cheerful imperial sabotage illustration. Mood: humanitarian violence.

cards.power: Patent Graveyard. Confiscate an opponent's 'Innovation' card. It is now a matter of national security.
cards.lore: Thousands of world-changing technologies mothballed because free energy is bad for the oil-backed imperial business model.
cards.gradeReason: Great suppression mechanic but the 1951 date creates a minor historical frame check.
cards.artworkPrompt: Free energy device sealed in black government filing cabinet stamped TOP SECRET. Style: bureaucratic absurdism. Mood: innovation murdered by paperwork.

cards.power: Closet Skeleton. Look at an opponent's hand. Force them to discard their best card or you reveal it to the table.
cards.lore: The original architect of the blackmail state. He ran the FBI like a personal gossip column, ensuring everyone in power owed him their silence.
cards.gradeReason: The blackmail choice mechanic puts players in Hoover's shoes immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bulldog in FBI suit clutching manila folder of secrets, political figures cowering behind him. Style: noir political cartoon. Mood: coercive institutional power.

cards.power: Elite Kompromat. Trap a high-level entity card. It now works for your cover due to mutually assured destruction.
cards.lore: The ultimate intelligence-gathering operation disguised as elite debauchery. The cameras were always running, and the client list is the real source of power.
cards.gradeReason: Trap a VIP with blackmail material—embodied the moment you play it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Luxury island with hidden cameras, VIP silhouettes, octopus intelligence agent at the controls. Style: dark espionage graphic novel. Mood: gilded entrapment.

cards.power: Blackmail 2.0. Fabricate a scandal. Opponent must pay a ransom of 3 Wealth or lose their turn.
cards.lore: In the digital age, truth is optional. Cybercriminals use AI to weaponize your own face against you. The ultimate scalable extortion.
cards.gradeReason: Fabricate scandal, collect ransom—digital blackmail mechanic enacted in real time.
cards.artworkPrompt: Neon wolf with deepfake screens showing distorted faces, ransom demand hovering in crypto. Style: cyberpunk noir. Mood: algorithmic menace.

cards.power: Deny & Counter-Attack. When attacked, ignore all rules. Scream louder than the opponent and sue them for damages.
cards.lore: McCarthy's right-hand man and the maestro of legal intimidation. He wielded blackmail and ruthlessness like a conductor's baton.
cards.gradeReason: 'Ignore rules, scream louder, sue'—you know exactly how to perform Roy Cohn the moment you read this.
cards.artworkPrompt: Wolverine-faced lawyer in pinstripe suit beating opponent with a gavel while screaming, papers flying. Style: legal thriller grotesque. Mood: gleeful procedural violence.

cards.power: Synthetic Monopoly. Ban all 'Natural Healing' cards from the game. Players must now pay a tariff for synthetic upgrades.
cards.lore: The Flexner Report ensured medicine was standardized into a petroleum-based, patentable, and highly profitable industrial extraction machine.
cards.gradeReason: Strong mechanic but the Flexner Report reference needs a beat of recognition.
cards.artworkPrompt: Oil derrick transforming into pharmaceutical pipeline feeding pills to patient conveyor belt. Style: industrial satire. Mood: profit-over-cure ruthlessness.

cards.power: Chemical Lobotomy. Dumb an opponent's character; they cannot attack, but they continue to consume products.
cards.lore: Filter out the naturally occurring trace minerals pharmaceutically, dominate it, and replace it with highly addictive, mood-flattening synthetics. Genial.
cards.gradeReason: Lobotomize opponent into a consumer who can't fight—immediate dark comedy embodiment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Sloth with glazed eyes in shopping mall, smile frozen, IV drip attached, cannot move but still buying. Style: pharmaceutical dystopia. Mood: cheerful sedation.

cards.power: Settlement Budget. Ignore all game penalties. Simply pay a small fraction of your profits as a 'fine' and continue playing.
cards.lore: A criminal syndicate with a PR department. Their rap sheet makes the traditional mob look like a scout troop selling cookies.
cards.gradeReason: Pay tiny fine, keep playing—mechanic enacts the impunity you're satirizing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Mafia don in lab coat holding settlement check, laughing at fine print while police look away. Style: crime drama parody. Mood: institutional impunity.

cards.power: Non-Consensual Field Test. Test a bioweapon on an opponent's city. Gain 1 'Research Data' point. Everyone's playing.
cards.lore: Stealing dead babies for radiation tests and spraying bacteria over San Francisco because science has a long tradition of treating citizens as lab rats.
cards.gradeReason: The bureaucratic lightness—'Gain 1 Research Data point. Everyone's playing'—makes it immediately horrifying and embodiable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Government scientist in hazmat suit happily spraying city from biplane, labeled 'civic improvement project.' Style: 1950s public safety poster inverted. Mood: cheerful atrocity.

cards.power: Accidental Leak. Roll a die. Unleash a virus. Everyone loses 2 Health, but you receive 5 Wealth tokens from the NIH.
cards.lore: Let's take a nasty virus and supercharge it in a lab with taxpayer money. What could possibly go wrong?
cards.gradeReason: Roll die, virus leaks, collect NIH check—the roulette mechanic IS the joke.
cards.artworkPrompt: Lab monkey in biohazard gloves spinning roulette wheel of viruses, NIH grant check ready nearby. Style: dark science noir. Mood: institutionally-endorsed catastrophe.

cards.power: Lockdown Wealth Transfer. Pause the game for 2 turns. Bankrupt all small players and transfer their assets to Big Tech and Pharma.
cards.lore: The greatest wealth redistribution in history, achieved by locking everyone inside and gaslighting them into compliance.
cards.gradeReason: You play a lockdown card that enacts a lockdown inside the actual card game—meta perfection.
cards.artworkPrompt: Monopoly board with lockdown tokens, small business pieces removed, Big Tech and Pharma pieces dominant, pig banker grinning. Style: board game parody. Mood: gleeful oligarchic redistribution.

cards.power: Predictive Programming. Play this card before a disaster hits to gain full control of the media narrative response.
cards.lore: Running tabletop exercises of global pandemics just months before the real thing drops. It's not a conspiracy; it's just excellent planning!
cards.gradeReason: Requires anticipating a future event—interesting mechanic but needs table setup to sing fully.
cards.artworkPrompt: Suited owl figures at simulation table while same pandemic scenario plays out in real world through window behind them. Style: dark institutional satire. Mood: convenient foresight.

cards.power: Liability Shield. When adverse effects trigger, automatically reclassify them as 'anxiety-related.' Collect 3 extra Pharma profit.
cards.lore: When the cure causes unprecedented cellular chaos, the industry doesn't panic—it just patents the new oncology treatments.
cards.gradeReason: Relabel side effects as anxiety, collect profit—mechanic enacts the corporate gaslighting instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Grim Reaper in pharmaceutical suit stamping SAFE & EFFECTIVE on side-effect warning labels, stock chart rising. Style: medical corporate satire. Mood: lethal cheerfulness.

cards.power: Narrative Colonization. Control the next 3 cards played by your opponents. They must declare it was their own idea.
cards.lore: The intelligence infiltration of media, academia, and entertainment. They don't write it; you just recite the lines.
cards.gradeReason: Control their moves AND make them claim credit—mechanic IS mind control, zero context needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: CIA mockingbird with TV antennas for wings, journalists on marionette strings reciting from the same script. Style: media conspiracy graphic novel. Mood: puppeted consensus.

cards.power: Algorithmic Gaslighting. Cancel an opponent's truth claim by labeling it 'Disinformation.' Lower their social standing to zero.
cards.lore: Welcome to the era of Algorithmic Authenticity™. The 5th-gen battlefield is your neocortex, and independent thought is highly suspicious.
cards.gradeReason: Hit 'disinformation' button, social standing drops to zero—instant cancel-culture embodiment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Robotic brain with FACT-CHECK laser beams vaporizing independent thoughts, social score meters tanking. Style: tech dystopia illustration. Mood: algorithmic certainty.

cards.power: Herd Immunity (to Logic). Hypnotize the player base. For 2 turns, all players must attack whoever refuses to conform.
cards.lore: A society mesmerized into submission by fear, isolation, and collective delusion. The new state religion demands absolute faith in The Narrative.
cards.gradeReason: 'Herd Immunity (to Logic)'—turn crowd against nonconformist. Embodied the moment you announce it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Hypnotized sheep mob surrounding one alert sheep, TV screens projecting spiral hypnosis. Style: crowd psychology horror. Mood: collective mesmerism.

cards.power: Whistleblower Drama. Reveal all hidden censorship cards. Chaos ensues, but nothing fundamentally changes.
cards.lore: Silicon Valley exposed as a digital Hunger Games where the government dips into the DMs to quarantine wrongthink like it had smallpox.
cards.gradeReason: The 'nothing changes' punchline is peak satire but requires knowing the Twitter saga to land fully.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bird-site cage exploding with censorship files while shrugging suited figures walk away unchanged. Style: media exposé graphic novel. Mood: cynical catharsis.

cards.power: Firmware Update. Back an opponent's character. You now control their moves and decisions are downgraded to firmware.
cards.lore: The billionaire dream: escape death, merge with the machine, and turn the peasantry into cloud-connected meat-routers.
cards.gradeReason: Compelling mechanic but 'transhumanist' as a label requires ideological recognition.
cards.artworkPrompt: Chimp with neural implant, movement controlled by distant tech mogul at a keyboard. Style: sci-fi corporate horror. Mood: gleeful dehumanization.

cards.power: Ubiquitous Surveillance. Look at everything yours. You know everything everywhere, always.
cards.lore: Microscopic sensors scattered in the air, food, and your local climate festival. It self-organizes and reports back to whoever holds the DARPA contract.
cards.gradeReason: Describes the tech more than inviting a persona; 'smart dust' has no clear performative stance to inhabit.
cards.artworkPrompt: Microscopic surveillance particles floating through air, city grid mapped in surveillance lines, DARPA logo watermark. Style: nanotechnology horror illustration. Mood: invisible omniscience.

cards.power: Cognitive Disruption. Opponents cannot strategize or sleep, they must play their next turn at a disadvantage.
cards.lore: It irradiates you like a side of beef and stops you from thinking clearly. But hey, your TikToks load instantly!
cards.gradeReason: Explains the theory but doesn't give players a clear performative persona to inhabit.
cards.artworkPrompt: 5G towers forming neural cage over city, TikTok logo as hypnotic beacon, figures scrolling zombified below. Style: techno-dystopia. Mood: cheerful irradiation.

cards.power: Algorithmic Exile. If an opponent acts aggressively, drop their ESG score. They can no longer buy, sell, or travel.
cards.lore: A Trojan horse for technocratic caste systems. Your compliance is mathematically graded; your freedom is a revocable privilege.
cards.gradeReason: Drop ESG, strand opponent—you ARE the technocratic enforcer the moment you play it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Camel frozen at gate with ESG: 000 score, city locked behind credit bars, compliance meter overhead. Style: dystopian social engineering. Mood: algorithmic castration.

cards.power: The Great Reset. Wipe the board of all middle-class assets. Transfer all property to the World Economic Forum.
cards.lore: The marketing puppet for the global elite, who want you to own nothing, eat the bugs, and thank it for the privilege of your digital serfdom.
cards.gradeReason: 'Wipe middle class, hand to WEF'—the card does the Great Reset in real time at the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Alien-headed figure in Davos suit looming over Monopoly board wiping out middle pieces, flying insects overhead. Style: WEF parody poster. Mood: cheerful feudal restoration.

cards.power: Geofencing. Restrict all players to their home quadrant. Travelling incurs a massive carbon tax penalty.
cards.lore: Because pandemic tyranny was so fun, they rebranded it as a climate emergency. Welcome to your eco-friendly open-air prison.
cards.gradeReason: Lock players to zones, tax movement—geofencing enacted at the game table instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Hamster wheel eco-pod city with carbon toll gates, globe temperature gauge as gatekeeper. Style: green dystopia design. Mood: sustainable incarceration.

cards.power: Global Health Sovereignty. Override all national laws. You now dictate health policy for the entire table.
cards.lore: Unelected bureaucrats demanding permanent emergency powers to manage the very crises they helped fund and create.
cards.gradeReason: Strong power but WHO as suprastate villain needs brief context at tables with casual players.
cards.artworkPrompt: Cobra with WHO logo coiled around national flags, health decree scroll unfurled. Style: international bureaucracy horror. Mood: unelected authority.

cards.power: False Choice. Create a fake resistance movement. Absorb all rebel energy and steer it into a harmless cul-de-sac.
cards.lore: The influencer-to-psyop pipeline. They monetize your fear, sell you merch, and feed you right back into the Matrix loop.
cards.gradeReason: Create fake rebels, vacuum their energy into dead end—you are the opposition the moment you play it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Puppet resistance leader with corporate handler strings, followers funneled into maze with no exit. Style: political underground satire. Mood: engineered futility.

cards.power: Ecclesiastical Aristocracy. Control global events from behind closed doors. Immune to all democracy.
cards.lore: The OG Roman powerhouses who never accepted the end of feudalism. God's oligarchs in Prada, pulling strings for centuries.
cards.gradeReason: Operating from behind closed doors is less theatrically direct—'immune to democracy' is great but who ARE you at the table?
cards.artworkPrompt: Aristocratic figures in ancient Roman garb behind Vatican walls, Prada logos, marionette strings on world leaders. Style: esoteric aristocracy illustration. Mood: ancient unaccountable power.

cards.power: Holy Espionage. Infiltrate an opponent's deck. Listen to their strategy and slowly consume them from within.
cards.lore: Accused of being the spiritual backbone of the clandestine cabal. When you're a 500-year-old secret society, why not aim for world domination?
cards.gradeReason: Infiltrate deck and consume from within—you become the shadow church the moment you play it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Robed owl figure infiltrating card deck, becoming the shadow beneath opponent's strategy. Style: religious conspiracy graphic. Mood: centuries-old patience.

cards.power: Suppressed History. Hide 3 artifact cards in the vault. They cannot be targeted or destroyed by any player.
cards.lore: Fifty miles of shelving holding everything from Galileo's trial to correspondence with dictators. God's filing cabinet of controversy.
cards.gradeReason: Defensive vault mechanic is useful but less performative—you're storing, not enacting.
cards.artworkPrompt: Skull in bishop's hat guarding endless Vatican library shelves with padlocked secrets. Style: gothic archival illustration. Mood: sacred suppression.

cards.power: Alien Ancestry. Reveal your true bloodline. Intimidate all human players and take an extra turn.
cards.lore: Conspiracy theorists claim the Pope's tall hat isn't just tradition—it's a custom cozy for genetically mutated, alien-hybrid skulls.
cards.gradeReason: 'Reveal alien bloodline, intimidate humans'—absurdist peak. You know exactly how to perform this instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Pope hat revealing elongated alien skull underneath, human players recoiling in reverence. Style: high-ceremony alien horror. Mood: sacred absurdism.

cards.power: Cosmic Rebellion. Summon the Watchers. Disrupt the entire game board with an apocalyptic flood event.
cards.lore: The ancient text too edgy for the Bible. A divine soap opera of fallen angels, giants, and cosmic politics that the church tried to bury.
cards.gradeReason: Summon Watchers, trigger flood—cosmic chaos on demand. No context needed: it's a divine smite card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Book of Enoch opening to release giant Watchers flooding game board, church officials fleeing. Style: apocalyptic biblical illustration. Mood: suppressed divine chaos.

cards.power: Metaphysical Download. Look through the entire deck. Take any card you choose. You now possess ultimate cosmic intel.
cards.lore: Heaven's cloud storage system. The mystical Wikipedia of all human consciousness, long before AI scraped your data.
cards.gradeReason: Access cosmic cloud, take any card—omniscience as a game mechanic, immediately satisfying.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ring-tailed lemur downloading cosmic scrolls from ethereal cloud server, cards floating around it. Style: mystical digital hybrid. Mood: transcendent insider trading.

cards.power: Free Energy. Generate unlimited resources. The player holding the 'Federal Reserve' card immediately attacks you.
cards.lore: Geniuses who bent time, space, and ether. Their tech could have freed humanity, so it was buried in black-budget vaults.
cards.gradeReason: Generate unlimited resources, immediately get attacked by banks—the irony IS the embodiment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Tesla-figure generating free energy lightning, black MiB agents materializing to confiscate it. Style: suppressed genius tragedy. Mood: beautiful futility.

cards.power: Government-Approved Astral Projection. Spy on any opponent's hand without them knowing. Bypass all physical defenses.
cards.lore: When Langley greenlit binaural beats to map the cosmos. Remote viewing and space-time escape, funded by your tax dollars.
cards.gradeReason: 'Government-approved astral projection'—plays itself the moment you announce it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Eagle in lotus pose astral projecting across table, CIA badge floating at crown chakra. Style: psychic operations illustration. Mood: cosmic bureaucracy.

cards.power: Antarctic Anomaly. Retreat to the Inner Earth. You are immune to all attacks for 3 turns.
cards.lore: Admiral Byrd went South and found more than penguins. A mysterious military expedition that resulted in a global treaty to never poke the ice wall again.
cards.gradeReason: Retreat to Inner Earth is evocative but Highjump/Byrd context needed to fully ignite.
cards.artworkPrompt: Admiral figure descending ice wall into hollow earth glowing realm, treaty paperwork floating behind. Style: arctic adventure conspiracy. Mood: forbidden cartography.

cards.power: Reverse Engineering. Acquire alien tech. Skip 3 turns of technological advancements and instantly dominate the board.
cards.lore: Mussolini recovered it. The Vatican hid it. The OSS stole it. The spark that ignited the 20th century black-budget aerospace supremacy.
cards.gradeReason: Get alien tech, leapfrog civilization—zero-context embodiment of hidden history's greatest heist.
cards.artworkPrompt: Magenta bell-shaped craft in Vatican catacombs, Italian fascist and OSS agent both reaching for it. Style: pulp history thriller. Mood: technological original sin.

cards.power: Aerosolized Ethics. Alter the weather. Destroy an opponent's agricultural resources and block their solar energy.
cards.lore: 200+ patents for weather modification, but if you look up and notice the grid patterns in the sky, you're just a crazy conspiracy theorist.
cards.gradeReason: Mechanic is clear but 'Aerosolized Ethics' and 'The Dimming' are terms that need a beat of recognition.
cards.artworkPrompt: Chemtrail grid spreading across sky, sun blocked, crops dying while weatherman shrugs at camera. Style: covert environmental satire. Mood: officially-denied agriculture warfare.

cards.power: Trans-Medium Travel. Ignore all terrain restrictions. Move anywhere on the board instantly.
cards.lore: Aquatic anomalies that laugh at your physics textbooks. The military sees them every day, but officially, they are just 'weather balloons in the ocean.'
cards.gradeReason: Ignore all terrain, move anywhere—pure freedom mechanic with zero setup, perfect wildcard.
cards.artworkPrompt: Glowing craft transitioning from ocean to air to space, naval vessel and dolphin watching. Style: UFO disclosure illustration. Mood: physics-defying freedom.

cards.power: Comfortable Defiance. Ignore all elite mandates. You cannot be locked down, censored, or psyoped while wearing the bathrobe.
cards.lore: In this house, we don't obey in our underwear. We resist in our bathrobes with tea, encrypted memes, and unrelenting sarcasm.
cards.gradeReason: 'We resist in our bathrobes'—you know exactly who you are the moment you put this on the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: FrizzleBob rabbit in heroic pose wearing bathrobe, holding mug of tea and laptop, elite mandates bouncing off him. Style: domestic resistance portrait. Mood: comfortable defiance.

cards.power: Subversive Fashion. Enter your enemy's sector. Opponents lose 1 Morale whenever they look at you.
cards.lore: Wearing the names of classified, horrific black ops as trendy streetwear. If they won't declassify history, we will accessorize it ironically.
cards.gradeReason: 'MK-ULTRA WAS A VIBE' hoodie aesthetic—instant ironic embodiment, no explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Cool rabbit in hoodie reading OPERATION PAPERCLIP ALUMNI, opponents losing confidence at the sight. Style: streetwear culture parody. Mood: ironic historical fashion.

cards.power: Nihilistic Joy. Deflect any psychological attack. Turn an opponent's fear-mongering into a hilarious joke.
cards.lore: When everything is fake and the world is run by psychopaths, laughter isn't just a coping mechanism—it's mental armor against mass formation.
cards.gradeReason: 'Turn fear-mongering into a joke'—you play this and immediately know you're cackling, not cowering.
cards.artworkPrompt: MAD Magazine cover shield deflecting fear propaganda arrows, laughter icons surrounding it. Style: satirical defense illustration. Mood: gleeful psychological resilience.

cards.power: Unplug the Matrix. Cancel all digital rules. For the rest of the game, players must resolve disputes by throwing actual dice.
cards.lore: If it looks designed or corporate, damage it. Real power is tactile, rowdy, and unplugged from the algorithm. Stay fluffy, stay free.
cards.gradeReason: Cancel digital rules, require physical dice—you embody anarchist hardware the moment you slam this down.
cards.artworkPrompt: Hairy wizard unplugging server rack, analog dice flying, algorithm screens going dark around him. Style: anti-tech counterculture. Mood: tactile liberation.

verdict: This is the deck that gets confiscated by your HOA. 56 cards of surgical geopolitical satire where the mechanics don't just mirror the content—they ARE the content: blackmail your opponent into compliance, crash the market, label someone Hitler and steal their oil. The standout strength is mechanic-text fusion at an elite level—Roy Cohn's card literally tells you to ignore all rules, and it works as game design AND cultural commentary simultaneously. Minor weakness: the Fringe & Frontlines section assumes conspiracy literacy casual players won't bring. Table-ready Y.
blurb: For players who suspected the geopolitical map was always a board game someone else was winning. 56 cards of epistemic sabotage—from Cecil Rhodes to Aladdin AI, no power pyramid goes unplumbed.

coverQA.coverVisual: 5 — Dense conspiracy iconography collage with FrizzleBob at center; every visual element earns its place
coverQA.coverTitle: 4 — 'Power Pyramid Plumbing & Global Psyop Wrestling' is irresistible but slightly wordy for a cover scan
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — Perfect tone alignment: satirical conspiratorial without credulous, FrizzleBob energy front and center
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — Strong signature style; 'Expansion Deck 01' label is slightly formulaic

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: POWER PYRAMID PLUMBING & GLOBAL PSYOP WRESTLING – The Expansion That Connects Every Racket (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

Somebody has been winning the geopolitical board your whole life, and you were never issued a piece. You were a square they moved across.

This is Expansion Deck 01, and it is built like a building. Fourteen rooms, one address. Imperial Kindergarten on the top floor, the Debt-Leash Ecosystem in the basement, the Rockefeller Medicine Show on the mezzanine, the Silicon Gulag in the new wing, the Holy Oligarchs in the penthouse. Walk it end to end and the same hand keeps moving the pieces, from Cecil Rhodes carving a continent for shareholders to an Aladdin AI quietly pricing the whole planet. The deck does not ask you to believe any single room. It walks you into the hallway and lets you notice the floor plan.

Social Story Wrestling, geopolitical edition: 56 cut-and-play cards where you do not watch the racket, you run it. You pick up a power move, you perform it out loud with a straight face, and the table rules whether the con holds or gets plumbed open mid-sentence. The mechanics are the message here. You blackmail a rival into compliance, you crash the market, you label someone a monster and walk off with the oil, and every move works as game design and as the evening news at the same time.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Power Pyramid Core Deck: 56 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards across 14 themed sections, featuring Roy Cohn's Legal Meatgrinder, The Scamdemic Board Game, and Operation Mockingbird.
- The Freestyle Rules: The complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, no security clearance, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and the Roy Cohn Clause, the one card allowed to ignore every rule on the table for as long as the room lets it stand.
- The Expansion Engine: fourteen mini-decks in one box, Imperial Kindergarten, Global Gladio Grid, Blackmail Economy, Scamdemic Psyop Board, Corporate Technocracy, Interdimensional Bureaucracy, and the rest, each a self-contained match you can run on its own or stack into the full pyramid.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
Grab this and you are not buying a frozen PDF. You are joining the cover-up cycle. Every future expansion in this series, every fresh room added to the building, lands in your library as a free update. The architecture is modular on purpose, so the floor plan keeps growing and your copy keeps up, no second checkout, no waiting for an official version to declassify.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I draw these because a power move you can name and perform yourself is a power move that loses its grip on you. Once you have run the Blackmail Economy at a kitchen table with your own hands, you spot the real thing in a press release before the spokesman finishes the line. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Cut it, play it, plumb the pyramid for free. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the time I spend drawing the next rooms and sharpening the rules.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
A pyramid only keeps its shape while nobody crawls into the plumbing. So crawl in.
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
